messages:
maria: Heads up — we need to finalize the plan for private/VPC metrics export so the new runtime dashboards can surface customer runtime + infra inputs. Timeline: want a canary by end of next sprint. Main constraints: some customers are air-gapped, others allow limited egress (proxy/IP allowlist), and most require KMS-wrapped payloads + audit hooks.

ajay: Are we planning a single export path (to Redwood) or multiple modes (to customer SIEM/S3 + to Redwood control plane)?

maria: Two modes: 1) Opt-in push to Redwood control plane for Console dashboards (minimal telemetry only: cpu/gpu util, batch sizes, latency p50/p95, model variant). 2) Push-to-customer endpoint (S3/HTTPS) for their SIEM/analytics. Both must support envelope encryption using customer KMS and produce auditable logs.

kevin: Security note — any push to us needs mTLS + per-tenant certs and an auditable key rotation policy. We must also provide guidance to strip any request-level PII before export. Can we limit data fields on the agent side?

ajay: Yes agent should have opt-in fields to whitelist metrics keys (no request text or full prompts). We'll add a metrics redact/whitelist config. Also planning mTLS client cert validation + sig verification of agent binary.

sylvia: Proposed agent config (example):
```yaml
metrics_agent:
  mode: push_https # or push_s3
  endpoint: https://metrics.redwood-internal.example.com:443
  tls:
    client_cert: /etc/redwood/certs/client.pem
    ca_bundle: /etc/redwood/certs/ca.pem
  allowed_metrics:
    - runtime.cpu_pct
    - runtime.gpu_pct
    - runtime.latency.p50
    - runtime.latency.p95
  kms_wrapping: 'aws:kms:arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:1234:key/abcd' # optional, customer-provided
```

sylvia: For push_s3 mode agent will PUT to a customer bucket with SSE-KMS; we only include metadata and aggregated metrics (no prompt-level data).

kevin: Firewall question: customers ask for IP allowlist rather than FQDN. Do we have stable IP ranges for the control-plane endpoints?

sylvia: Short answer: currently domain-based fronted by cloud load balancers. We can publish a CIDR range but it may change. Options: 1) provide a fixed egress NAT IP range per region (preferred), 2) recommend customers route via a proxy that can do FQDN allowlist, 3) support outbound via customer-managed relay (we ship a small relay image).

ajay: For on-prem/air-gapped: we should support a local relay that writes to S3 or file and an offline transfer process. That keeps the agent simple and audit-friendly.

kevin: Audit hooks — we need a documented auditd/syslog snippet that records every metrics-agent push and KMS wrapping ops. Example syslog entry format: `METRICS_PUSH tenant=<id> mode=push_https bytes=1234 wrapped_with=kms:arn`

ryan: UX/rollout note — Console needs: per-tenant toggle (allow metrics export), view of last successful push, and audit log link. Devex wants a one-click onboarding doc + chef/helm chart for agent.

maria: Action items: sylvia — produce egress IP/CIDR recommendation + relay image by EOD Friday; ajay — add whitelist/redact config and mTLS client cert support; kevin — write audit logging guidance + PII checklist; ryan — mock Console toggle and onboarding doc. I'll own product acceptance criteria.

kevin: I'll also draft the security review checklist and send to legal for SOC requirements.

ryan: I can wireframe the toggle in Console tomorrow and link to docs: https://docs.redwood.com/private-metrics-export

ops-bot: deploybot: new metrics-agent image built: sha256:deadbeef — pushing to staging cluster. :rocket:

ajay: Quick question on KMS: if customer provides KMS key (AWS/GCP/Azure), agent must be able to perform envelope encryption locally and send wrapped payloads; confirm?

kevin: Confirmed. Agent performs local envelope encryption, we never see plaintext for customer-targeted exports. For Redwood-control-plane exports we either accept a customer-wrapped blob or use our tenancy-specific key with strict access controls.

maria: This looks good. If nobody objects we'll socialise the plan with solutions eng + account reps tomorrow. sylvia: please post the IP/CIDR & relay docker image link when ready.

sylvia: Will do.

maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
